name: ITT-ProductPhotos
description: Product/ad-format screenshots for Informa TechTarget. When building slides, decks, one-pagers, or any branded layout that needs to show what an ITT ad product looks like in-context, read this manifest to pick the right image and pull it by raw URL.

_how_to_pull.instructions: Each image has a `path` relative to the repo root. Build a raw URL as `${raw_base}/${path}`. Fill in raw_base with your repo's owner/name/branch. Then fetch or embed that URL.

selection_guide: Match the task to an image using `use_when` and `tags`. If a task mentions display ads, banners, leaderboards, or native units across devices, use DisplayAds.png. If it mentions Industry Dive, blimp/pushdown ads, or skyscraper/right-rail ads, use IndustryDiveBlimpSkyscraperAds.jpg.

images.title: TechTarget display / native ads across devices
images.description: Mockup showing TechTarget display and native ad units rendered responsively across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Depicts a leaderboard/banner ('Securing Access in the Digital Workspace') and a RADIUS/VMware native ad unit ('Secure Access in the Digital Workspace') on a TechTarget CIO editorial article page.
use_when: Showing what TechTarget display ads look like in-context
Illustrating responsive / cross-device ad rendering (desktop, tablet, mobile)
Slides about display advertising, banner ads, leaderboards, or native ad units

images.title: Industry Dive blimp + skyscraper ads
images.description: Screenshot of an Industry Dive editorial article page showing two ad placements in-context: a 'blimp' (top banner / pushdown unit) and a 'skyscraper' (vertical right-rail unit). Example creative is a 'Protect Your Fall Start' college campaign.
use_when: Showing Industry Dive ad placements in-context
images.quality_note: Low resolution (255x307). Best for thumbnails or small inline references; may look soft if scaled up.
